prompt: Create an original 180 second Chinese plucked-string ensemble instrumental composition for rest, unwinding and breathing exercises. Mood: peaceful, soft, spacious. Instruments: pipa, yangqin, dizi, frame drum. Style: crisp plucked ostinato with bright bamboo-flute answers. Tempo approximately 90 BPM; F major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use a restrained arrangement, soft attacks, no sudden accents. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A serene and elegant instrumental piece featuring traditional Chinese instruments like guzheng and a dizi-like flute, accompanied by orchestral strings (both pizzicato and bowed), harp, and light percussion. The melody is gentle and flowing, creating a peaceful and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静而优雅的纯音乐，以古筝和笛子等中国传统乐器为主，辅以管弦乐弦乐（拨弦和弓弦）、竖琴和轻柔的打击乐。旋律轻柔流畅，营造出平和而富有沉思的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
